examples: See from across the room that one agent is waiting for a permission answer.
Know which sessions finished while you were away, by their unread ring.
how_to: Read the light: green is working, yellow is waiting on you, light blue wants attention, grey is idle, red is dead or disconnected.
A ring around it marks an unread turn; hover for the exact state and where it came from.
A moon means the session is asleep; a green moon means you flagged it unread to follow up.
A red skull means the session hit its usage limit; hover for when it resets.
name: Session status lights
summary: a two-part light on every session that shows what it's doing and whether it needs you, from across the room.
where: On every session: drawer rows, tabs, the running sessions list.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
